schema:name: Liu et al. (2025) Experimental Sulfide LA-ICP-MS Spot v1
schema:description: laicpmsTAPP instance derived from Liu et al. 2025 (GCA 393) Experimental sulfide Spot analysis ns-LA-Q-ICP-MS Guangzhou Inst. Geochemistry (column W of LA-Q_SF-ICPMS_TAPP_v3.xlsx 'TAPP' worksheet).

schema:location.schema:name: State Key Laboratory of Isotope Geochemistry, Guangzhou Institute of Geochemistry, CAS, China

ada:spotGeometryDefault: 20 µm circular (sulfide; grain sizes >20 µm selected)
ada:ablationSpotDurationDefault: ~40 s (same protocol; grain size >20 µm selected)
ada:carrierGasFlowRateDefault: He (flow rate not stated; same system as glass protocol)
ada:analysisSequenceDefault: Same bracketing as silicate glass protocol
ada:internalStandardApproach: Single element from EMP: Fe (FeOT from EMP for sulfide); NIST 610 as external standard
ada:internalStandardElement: Fe from EMP (FeOT wt% for sulfide)
ada:elementalFractionationCorrection: Femtosecond laser reduces LIEF; NIST 610 external standard; Fe IS from EMP corrects for ablation yield; micronuggets identified from Au signal spikes and excluded from integration
ada:signalIntegrationIntervalMethod: Same approach as glass; micronugget identification from Au signal spikes critical for sulfide analyses
ada:primaryCalibrationStandardNameDefaul: NIST 610 (primary external standard); Fe from EMP as IS
ada:calibrationStandardMeasurementFreque: Same bracketing as silicate glass protocol
ada:secondaryReferenceMaterialDefault: NIST SRM 612 and BCR-2G (same monitoring standard set as glass protocol)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Plasma / Make-up Gas Addition
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: N₂ or Ar mixed (same protocol as glass)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: No post-acquisition normalization beyond IS (Fe from EMP)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Multi-Run Sequential Analysis Design
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Single spot per location (sulfides; same acquisition parameters as glass but 20 µm spot)

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: Analyzed constituent
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: Analyzed constituent (isotope) identified by the analyte row.

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Same approach as glass; Au spike identification critical for determining solubility vs. nugget contribution
